title: Flow Core Dsl Engine Adoption
description: Build dsl:: engine support from scratch for flow/core/rs (package flow_core) — the crate holding FlowHost, FlowFixture, FlowDocument. Step 1: delete FlowHost's redundant snapshot-based undo/redo (FlowHistory struct + undo()/redo() around lines 1719/3220/3233), route undo/redo through the standard vcs::DocumentVcsStore/DocumentVcsEnvelope mechanism (FlowOperation/FlowDiff already implement vcs::Operation/OperationDiff correctly at lines ~4109-4230), rewrite undo_redo_add_widget test (~line 5290) to exercise vcs-based undo/redo. Step 2: add dsl:: derive layer — #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)] on FlowFixture (schema/camera/widgets/synapses/layout), dsl::DslOps on FlowOperation, local twins for foreign not-yet-converted types (neural_engine Dictionary/NeuralValue/Atom if embedded in Widget params), use already-converted infinite_board_port_directed_dag and mathematical_graph_manifest PropertyValue/PropertyBag directly if present. Convert flow/example/default.flow.json fixture from JSON to real .flow DSL text via migration-test round-trip procedure; check whether flow/manifest/dag.manifest.json is part of the document round trip or a separate build artifact. Verify with cargo test -p flow_core and cargo test -p flow-plugin (confirm exact name), CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-flow-dslgreen-target. Per "wave G / greenfield" of the technologies dsl migration plan.
summary:
Definitively confirmed `tests::neural_cache_persists_across_evaluations` was a pre-existing bug, not caused by the FlowHistory→vcs migration: built a full clean scratch clone of HEAD (3b1d1c984) in an isolated directory (patching in several gitignored-but-required generated/build-artifact paths — mathematical/graph/manifest/generated, ui/asset/icon/generated, ui/styling/generated, framework/schema/generated, framework/plugin/registry/generated, framework/core/js/generated, mathematical/graph/distance/rs — so Cargo.toml and lib.rs stayed in sync, unlike the earlier single-file revert attempt) and reproduced the identical failure (`left: 1, right: 0` at the same assertion) with zero session changes present.

Root cause was in the test, not the caching logic: `compute_dirty_set` intentionally treats `previous == None` (the very first `evaluate_internal()` call) as "everything dirty" (documented in its own doc comment), so the first evaluation after `set_neuron_kind_infos_json` correctly dispatches to the eval bridge once for the `add` node — the test wrongly asserted 0. It also asserted the call count became 1 immediately after `set_slider_value` with no follow-up `evaluate_internal()` call, but `set_slider_value` never auto-evaluates (per `slider_updates_preview`'s doc comment on that design change). Three sibling tests in the same file already use the correct pattern (capture a `baseline` after the first `evaluate_internal()`, then assert deltas after mutation + an explicit follow-up `evaluate_internal()`) — rewrote `neural_cache_persists_across_evaluations` to match that pattern instead of asserting hardcoded 0s, and added the missing `evaluate_internal()` call after `set_slider_value`.

Verified: `cargo test -p flow_core` → 91 passed, 0 failed (previously 90 passed, 1 failed).
